filter_repo_objects_paths: filter repo objects using allow_patterns and ignore_patterns on a list of string paths
filter_repo_objects_objects: filter arbitrary objects by path extracted via a key function with allow and ignore patterns
filter_repo_objects_single_pattern: filter repo objects with a single allow_pattern string and a single ignore_pattern string
filter_repo_objects_no_patterns: filter repo objects without any patterns to return all str or Path items unchanged
add_wildcard_to_directories: add wildcard suffix to directory patterns ending with a trailing slash
